newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - March 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - March 25.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
PEOPLE'S DAILY
- General Office of Communist Party central committee orders leading officials to report private matters, including foreign marriages and jobs in foreign businesses of family members
- Editorial says new regulations are important in supervision of leading officials
- Vice Premier Wu Bangguo urges cut in surplus staff in state enterprises
FINANCIAL NEWS
- State Planning Commission approves China's second build-operate-transfer project - Sichuan Chengdu Number 6 Waterworks phase four
- PICC Property farm insurance premiums up 15.8 percent in 1996
- Central Bank approves Shantou city to open urban cooperative bank
INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS DAILY
- Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation lashes out at EU for anti-dumping charges against China and for treating China has non-market economy
ECONOMIC DAILY
- State Statistical Bureau survey finds net income of rural Chinese hit 1,926 yuan, up inflation-adjusted 9.0 percent in 1996
ECONOMIC INFORMATION DAILY
- Power Ministry says not to hike electricity price
- China to build new nuclear plant at Yangjiang with total investment of $3.5 billion
MARKET DAILY
- Founder Corp announces price cut in its computers
CHINA DAILY
- China sees no early resumption of talks with Taiwan
